Lesson 1: 九月去北京旅游最好 (Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo) - September is the best time to visit Beijing
足球 (zúqiú) - football
椅子 (yǐzi) - chair
猫 (māo) - cat
三月 (sān yuè) - March
六月 (liù yuè) - June
九月 (jiǔ yuè) - September
十二月 (shí'èr yuè) - December
Grammar: Negative form of the auxiliary verb 要 is usually 不想 (e.g. 小王要去，我不想去)
Grammar: 几 + measure word + noun (几 indicates an indefinite number less than 10, e.g. 几个人, 几本书)
Grammar: 几 after 十 means 11-19 (十几个人); 几 before 十 means 21-99 (几十个人)
Grammar: Numeral below 10 + measure word + 多 + noun (三个多星期, 五年多, 六个多月)
Grammar: Integer above 10 + 多 + measure word + noun (十多个月, 二十多块钱, 八十多个人); 多 and 几 are interchangeable here
Pronunciation: Disyllabic "Medium-stressed + Stressed" structure (中重格式): second syllable stressed and longer, e.g. 冰箱, 帮忙, 打扰, 高兴, 旅游, 可能, 开始, 考试
Pronunciation: Disyllabic "Stressed + Light" structure (重轻格式): first syllable stressed, second light and short, e.g. 东西, 窗户, 萝卜, 时候, 枕头, 你们, 告诉, 故事

Origin of 为 (wéi): complex form 爲 looks like a hand pulling an elephant to work for people; original meaning "to work/do"
Origin of 也 (yě): ancient form looks like a long snake with a pointed head; original meaning lost, now used as an adverb

Character 级 (jí) - level, grade
Pronunciation: Trisyllabic "Medium-stressed + Stressed + Light" structure (中重轻格式, not many words): second syllable stressed and longest, e.g. 胡萝卜, 没关系, 老狐狸, 毛孩子
Pronunciation: Trisyllabic "Stressed + Light + Light" structure (重轻轻格式, very few, mostly colloquial): first syllable stressed, others light, e.g. 什么的, 怪不得, 姑娘家, 好着呢
Pronunciation: Trisyllabic "Medium-stressed + Light + Stressed" structure (中轻重格式, most trisyllabic words): third syllable stressed and longest, e.g. 收音机, 新加坡, 好莱坞, 电视剧

Character 笔 (bǐ) - pen

Origin of 生 (shēng): original form looks like a young seedling sprouting from the earth; original meaning "to germinate and grow"; now many meanings, e.g. 生病 (to get ill), 生活 (to live)
Origin of 高 (gāo): original form looks like a tall pavilion; means "tall"

我要去北京旅游，你觉得什么时候去最好？ (Wǒ yào qù Běijīng lǚyóu, nǐ juéde shénme shíhou qù zuì hǎo?) - I'm thinking of a trip to Beijing. When do you think is the best time?
九月去北京旅游最好。 (Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo.) - September is the best time to visit Beijing.
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
九月的北京天气不冷也不热。 (Jiǔ yuè de Běijīng tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè.) - Because it's neither cold nor hot there in September.
你喜欢什么运动？ (Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?) - What sport do you like?
我最喜欢踢足球。 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tī zúqiú.) - I like playing football.
下午我们一起去踢足球吧。 (Xiàwǔ wǒmen yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba.) - Let's go to play football this afternoon.
好啊！ (Hǎo a!) - Great!
我们要不要买几个新的椅子？ (Wǒmen yào bu yào mǎi jǐ ge xīn de yǐzi?) - Don't you think we should buy some new chairs?
好啊。 (Hǎo a.) - Yes.
什么时候去买？ (Shénme shíhou qù mǎi?) - When shall we go to buy them?
明天下午怎么样？ (Míngtiān xiàwǔ zěnmeyàng?) - What about tomorrow afternoon?
你明天几点能回来？ (Nǐ míngtiān jǐ diǎn néng huílai?) - When will you be back tomorrow?
三点多。 (Sān diǎn duō.) - A little bit later after three o'clock.
桌子下面有个猫。 (Zhuōzi xiàmiàn yǒu ge māo.) - There is a cat under the table.
那是我的猫，它叫花花。 (Nà shì wǒ de māo, tā jiào Huāhua.) - It's my cat Huahua.
它很漂亮。 (Tā hěn piàoliang.) - It's beautiful.
是啊，我觉得它的眼睛最漂亮。 (Shì a, wǒ juéde tā de yǎnjing zuì piàoliang.) - Yes. I think it has the most beautiful eyes.
它多大了？ (Tā duō dà le?) - How old is it?
六个多月。 (Liù ge duō yuè.) - More than six months.
王方要学习英语。 (Wáng Fāng yào xuéxí Yīngyǔ.) - Wang Fang wants to study English.
我要吃米饭。 (Wǒ yào chī mǐfàn.) - I want to eat rice.
我们要不要买几个新的椅子？ (Wǒmen yào bu yào mǎi jǐ ge xīn de yǐzi?) - Shall we buy some new chairs?
小王要去，我不想去。 (Xiǎo Wáng yào qù, wǒ bù xiǎng qù.) - Xiao Wang wants to go, but I don't want to go.
你要吃米饭吗？ (Nǐ yào chī mǐfàn ma?) - Do you want to eat rice?
我不想吃米饭。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng chī mǐfàn.) - I don't want to eat rice.
我要去商店买椅子，你去吗？ (Wǒ yào qù shāngdiàn mǎi yǐzi, nǐ qù ma?) - I want to go to the shop to buy chairs. Are you going?
我不去，我不想买椅子。 (Wǒ bú qù, wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi yǐzi.) - I'm not going; I don't want to buy chairs.
大卫的汉语最好。 (Dàwèi de Hànyǔ zuì hǎo.) - David's Chinese is the best.
我最喜欢吃米饭。 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī mǐfàn.) - I like eating rice the most.
它的眼睛最漂亮。 (Tā de yǎnjing zuì piàoliang.) - Its eyes are the most beautiful.
车上有几个人。 (Chē shàng yǒu jǐ ge rén.) - There are several people in the car.
我想买几本书。 (Wǒ xiǎng mǎi jǐ běn shū.) - I want to buy a few books.
什么时候去北京旅游最好？ (Shénme shíhou qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo?) - When is the best time to visit Beijing?
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
他们下午要做什么？ (Tāmen xiàwǔ yào zuò shénme?) - What are they going to do this afternoon?
他们想什么时候去买椅子？ (Tāmen xiǎng shénme shíhou qù mǎi yǐzi?) - When do they want to go to buy chairs?
花花在哪儿？ (Huāhua zài nǎr?) - Where is Huahua?
花花多大了？ (Huāhua duō dà le?) - How old is Huahua?
我要去买____个新杯子。 (Wǒ yào qù mǎi _____ ge xīn bēizi.) - I am going to buy ____ new cups. (fill in the blank)
你____买衣服，去那个商店吧。 (Nǐ _____ mǎi yīfu, qù nàge shāngdiàn ba.) - You ____ buy clothes, go to that shop. (fill in the blank)
我的猫三岁____了，你的猫多大了？ (Wǒ de māo sān suì _____ le, nǐ de māo duō dà le?) - My cat is three years old ____; how old is your cat? (fill in the blank)
我不想学习，我想和朋友去____。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng xuéxí, wǒ xiǎng hé péngyou qù _____.) - I do not want to study; I want to go ____ with my friends. (fill in the blank)
你最喜欢吃什么？ (Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī shénme?) - What do you like to eat most?
最不喜欢吃什么？ (Zuì bù xǐhuan chī shénme?) - What do you like to eat least?
你最喜欢什么运动？ (Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?) - What sport do you like most?
我的朋友____，他最喜欢____，最不喜欢____。 (Wǒ de péngyou _____, tā zuì xǐhuan _____, zuì bù xǐhuan _____.) - My friend ____; he likes ____ the most and ____ the least. (fill in the blanks)
你最想去什么地方旅游？ (Nǐ zuì xiǎng qù shénme dìfang lǚyóu?) - Where do you most want to go to travel?
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
你最不想去什么地方旅游？ (Nǐ zuì bù xiǎng qù shénme dìfang lǚyóu?) - Where do you least want to go to travel?
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
他想学汉语，想吃中国菜。 (Tā xiǎng xué Hànyǔ, xiǎng chī Zhōngguó cài.) - He wants to learn Chinese and wants to eat Chinese food.

马丁早上……，下午……，晚上……，星期六和星期天…… (Mǎdīng zǎoshang……, xiàwǔ……, wǎnshang……, xīngqī liù hé xīngqītiān……) - Martin in the morning ..., in the afternoon ..., in the evening ..., on Saturday and Sunday ... (talk about what Martin does at what time)
你很少生病，是不是喜欢运动？ (Nǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng, shì bu shì xǐhuan yùndòng?) - You seldom get sick. I guess you like doing sports, don't you?
是啊，我每天早上都要出去跑步。 (Shì a, wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dōu yào chūqu pǎo bù.) - Yes. I go out for a jog every morning.
你每天几点起床？ (Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?) - What time do you get up?
我每天六点起床。 (Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.) - I get up at six every day.
吃药了吗？ (Chī yào le ma?) - Did you take your medicine?
现在身体怎么样？ (Xiànzài shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?) - How do you feel now?
吃了。 (Chī le.) - Yes, I did.
现在好多了。 (Xiànzài hǎo duō le.) - I feel much better now.
什么时候能出院？ (Shénme shíhou néng chū yuàn?) - When can you leave the hospital?
医生说下个星期。 (Yīshēng shuō xià ge xīngqī.) - Next week according to the doctor.
大卫今年多大？ (Dàwèi jīnnián duō dà?) - How old is David?
二十多岁。 (Èrshí duō suì.) - Above 20 years old.
他多高？ (Tā duō gāo?) - How tall is he?
一米八几。 (Yì mǐ bā jǐ.) - He is more than 180 centimeters tall.
你怎么知道这么多啊？ (Nǐ zěnme zhīdào zhème duō a?) - How come you know so much about him?
他是我同学。 (Tā shì wǒ tóngxué.) - He is my classmate.
张老师星期六也不休息啊？ (Zhāng lǎoshī xīngqī liù yě bù xiūxi a?) - Doesn't Mr. Zhang take Saturday off?
是啊，他这几天很忙，没有时间休息。 (Shì a, tā zhè jǐ tiān hěn máng, méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.) - Yes. He has been busy lately. He has no time to rest.
那会很累吧？ (Nà huì hěn lèi ba?) - That must be really tiring.
他每天回来都很累。 (Tā měi tiān huílai dōu hěn lèi.) - Every day he comes home exhausted.
你很少生病，是不是喜欢运动？ (Nǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng, shì bu shì xǐhuan yùndòng?) - You seldom get sick. I guess you like doing sports, don't you?
是不是明天爸爸休息？ (Shì bu shì míngtiān bàba xiūxi?) - Is Dad off tomorrow?
我们星期一去北京，是不是？ (Wǒmen xīngqī yī qù Běijīng, shì bu shì?) - We are going to Beijing on Monday, aren't we?
山姆每年都去中国旅游。 (Shānmǔ měi nián dōu qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.) - Sam goes to China to travel every year.
你每个星期六都工作吗？ (Nǐ měi ge xīngqī liù dōu gōngzuò ma?) - Do you work every Saturday?
我每天六点起床。 (Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.) - I get up at six every day.
你多大？ (Nǐ duō dà?) - How old are you?
我16岁。 (Wǒ shíliù suì.) - I am 16 years old.
王医生的儿子多高？ (Wáng yīshēng de érzi duō gāo?) - How tall is Doctor Wang's son?
他儿子一米七。 (Tā érzi yì mǐ qī.) - His son is 1.7 meters tall.
他多高？ (Tā duō gāo?) - How tall is he?
一米八几。 (Yì mǐ bā jǐ.) - He is more than 1.8 meters tall.
他为什么很少生病？ (Tā wèi shénme hěn shǎo shēng bìng?) - Why does he seldom get sick?
他每天几点起床？ (Tā měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?) - What time does he get up every day?
她现在身体怎么样？ (Tā xiànzài shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?) - How is she feeling now?
大卫今年多高？ (Dàwèi jīnnián duō gāo?) - How tall is David this year?
多大？ (Duō dà?) - How old?
张老师星期六休息吗？ (Zhāng lǎoshī xīngqī liù xiūxi ma?) - Does Mr. Zhang rest on Saturday?
小丽____天都很忙，也很累。 (Xiǎolì _____ tiān dōu hěn máng, yě hěn lèi.) - Xiao Li is busy and also tired ____ day. (fill in the blank)
他每天早上出去____，身体很好。 (Tā měi tiān zǎoshang chūqu _____, shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) - Every morning he goes out to ____; his health is very good. (fill in the blank)
王医生的儿子多____？ (Wáng yīshēng de érzi duō _____?) - How ____ is Doctor Wang's son? (fill in the blank)
我听说安妮____了，我想去看看她。 (Wǒ tīngshuō Ānni _____ le, wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan tā.) - I heard Annie has ____; I want to go and see her. (fill in the blank)
你每天几点吃早饭？ (Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn chī zǎofàn?) - What time do you have breakfast every day?
你每天什么时候运动？ (Nǐ měi tiān shénme shíhou yùndòng?) - When do you exercise every day?
你多大？ (Nǐ duō dà?) - How old are you?
你多高？ (Nǐ duō gāo?) - How tall are you?
你每天做什么运动？ (Nǐ měi tiān zuò shénme yùndòng?) - What sports do you do every day?
每天早上跑步，每个星期六踢足球。 (Měi tiān zǎoshang pǎo bù, měi ge xīngqī liù tī zúqiú.) - Runs every morning and plays football every Saturday.
这块手表是你的吗？ (Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?) - Is this watch yours?
不是我的。 (Bú shì wǒ de.) - No, it isn't.
是我爸爸的。 (Shì wǒ bàba de.) - It's my father's.
多少钱买的？ (Duōshao qián mǎi de?) - How much is it?
三千多块。 (Sānqiān duō kuài.) - More than 3,000 yuan.
这是今天早上的报纸吗？ (Zhè shì jīntiān zǎoshang de bàozhǐ ma?) - Is it this morning's newspaper?
不是，是昨天的。 (Bú shì, shì zuótiān de.) - No, it isn't. It's yesterday's.
你听，是不是送报纸的来了？ (Nǐ tīng, shì bu shì sòng bàozhǐ de lái le?) - Listen. Is that the man who delivers newspaper?
我看一下。 (Wǒ kàn yíxià.) - Let me see.
不是，是送牛奶的。 (Bú shì, shì sòng niúnǎi de.) - No, it's the milkman.
